info.title: AIC Foundation and Local MVP Sandbox
info.description: Local sandbox freeze: unresolved counterparty CRUD, case/Exposure including exact questionnaire sources, immutable documents and field verification, bounded manual retry, native capability invitations/forms, Transaction Review, financial fact registry and gated ratios. Explicit local opt-in only. Numeric FHI activation, legal identity confirmation, public ingress and production deployment are not released.

parameters.name: X-CSRF-Token
parameters.description: Required for an active session; expired/revoked session still204 with valid Origin

parameters.name: set_id
parameters.description: Explicit statement set within this case. Required to calculate ratios when multiple sets exist; never mixes periods or bases.

X-Invitation-Token.description: Raw capability secret, delivered on the first committed response only, never on replay. The frozen JSON body contains metadata only. A lost secret requires explicit reissue/revocation; do not retry with a new key automatically.

respondentCapability.description: High-entropy invitation capability; no specialist session cookie. Token conveys scoped access only, not legal identity assurance.

sessionCookie.name: aic_fe_qa
sessionCookie.description: Default transport name; server configuration may override consistently.
